exceptions.description: The protocol warmup string mentions initial B and P warmup, but the frozen run source actually warms only P, symmetrically on both backends at depths 3 and 5. Before-pair warmup is P at depth 3 as declared.
exceptions.disposition: Retain the frozen source, settings, openings and all games. No B player participates in this comparison. This is a metadata-description discrepancy, not a model or asymmetric treatment change; disclose it with the results.
